thread:
maria: Quick readout from the Kestrel POC — posting final metrics + gaps + proposed next steps. Deck in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/kestrel-poc :spiral_calendar:

sam_k: great — can you call out the success criteria we agreed and whether they met each one?

jin: Summary from eval harness:
- use cases tested: clinical note summarization, triage routing, eligibility QA
- eval set: 1.2k prompts (mix of short/long dialogs)
- metrics:
  • p95 latency (hosted API): 190ms ✅
  • semantic accuracy (QA F1): 0.82 (target 0.85) ⚠️
  • hallucination rate (manual spot-check): ~4% (target <3%) ⚠️
  • throughput: sustained 120 reqs/s with 8-token avg streaming
  • cost per 1k tokens (hosted): $1.45

jin: Note — accuracy gap concentrated on multi-turn eligibility prompts where they require strict rule recall.

evans (evan): eng notes: we saw cache thrash when long dialogues hit different patient ids; switching to per-patient prefix caching helped reduce token regen by ~22%. We also toggled quantization profile q4_0 for latency win on dedicated nodes.

claudia: Security items still open:
- KMS integration: customer requires AWS KMS/HSM — awaiting architecture diagram from infra team.
- Data retention: they want 30-day ephemeral logs + export for audits. Need legal sign-off on retention policy.
- SCQ (security questionnaire): 18/23 answered, outstanding: encryption in transit details + SOC2 report date.

sam_k: Pricing questions from the buyer:
- they asked about committed vs on-demand delta and overage policy
- requested a 3-month pilot uplift discount if they commit to Dedicated afterwards

maria: Proposed commercial path:
1) SOW addendum for 90-day pilot on Dedicated small pool (2 GPUs) — committed $11k/mo equivalent usage credit, on-demand fallback enabled.
2) If pilot KPI pass (see pass criteria below) — 12mo Dedicated term with ramp schedule + standard enterprise SLA.

maria: Pass criteria (proposed):
- p95 latency < 220ms in production-like traffic
- QA F1 >= 0.85 on blinded eval set
- hallucination rate < 3% on random sample of 500 responses
- stability: <1% error rate and no more than 2 incident-level outages during pilot
\jin: Attached a representative prompt and eval snippet used in the tests:
```
Prompt (eligibility):
"Patient has history of X, Y, and current meds A. Based on clinical guidelines, is patient eligible for study Z? Provide rationale and cite rule id."
```

jin: Eval harness output (example):
- expected: eligible=false, rule_id=RG-12
- model: eligible=true, rule_id=RG-7  <-- mismatch (common failure mode)

evans: Engineering remediation suggestions:
- add deterministic rule overlay for eligibility checks (hybrid approach)
- increase prefix cache TTL per patient to avoid recontexting across steps
- tune prompt templates to include explicit "must cite rule id" instruction

claudia: For security/compliance path: I'll coordinate with legal and infra to get KMS diagram and SOC2 attestation. ETA Monday COB.

sam_k: Sales asks: can we get a draft SOW + pilot pricing by EOD Monday so we can present in buyer steering call Tues?

maria: Yes — I'll draft SOW. Jin/evan — can you produce the minimal infra appendix (GPU sizing, runtimes, expected token burn) by Monday morning?

jin: On it. Will post estimated token projection table.

evans: I'll produce the infra appendix and include the cache config we tested.

maria: Action items:
- maria: draft SOW + commercial terms (EOD Mon)
- jin: token projection + eval artifact (Mon AM)
- evan: infra appendix + cache/quant profiles (Mon AM)
- claudia: KMS diagram + SOC2 note (Mon COB)
- sam_k: prep buyer steering slide and negotiation points (Tues)

maria: Final note: customer is excited about latency wins and dev DX. The decision hinges on accuracy on eligibility use case + security assurances. If we close pilot terms quickly we can convert to Dedicated with 2-3x scale within 90 days. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Automated note: a dedicated pilot SKU will require infra provisioning lead time ~7 business days once SOW signed.
